== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The crack in the sky is a visual phenomenon appearing as a dark, jagged fracture or black lightning bolt across the atmosphere. While it may resemble a break in an eggshell, it is actually a rift or gateway that connects the world to a massive void. This opening serves as a means of transportation for the [[Great Elders]], who use these rifts to travel to and from the void. The phenomenon is not a single occurrence but is being actively maintained by the collective power of these [[Elders]], effectively acting as a breach in a prison. Some suggest that fighting near the [[Optasia]] may have caused the rift, and while it can appear as a winding stripe of heat haze or a transparent worm, it is ultimately a wound in reality that allows death to pass between worlds. If the influence of the [[Great Elders]] is sufficiently weakened or sealed, the world has the potential to heal itself.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The crack in the sky is a Shadow{{!}}shadow-bleeding gash in reality that serves as a break in the prison of the [[Fiends]]. This rift was created by the [[Optasia]] following a plan orchestrated by [[Ach'magut|Ach’magut]]. While [[Urg’naut]]'s [[Shadow|shadow]] connects to this phenomenon, [[Calder]] finds himself unable to do much about the crack in the sky.}}
